name: pmns_delta_cp
tier: Tier 3 phase ansatz (2 pi phi^-1) + Tier 3 PMNS-sector magnitude/disposition pending O.7 and the theta_23 octant + Tier 4 as evidence that phi explains the value (constant control test v3 NEGATIVE-FRAGILE; App PSC §PSC.9.6)
app_psc_precision_str: +0.4 sigma with SK; +2.4 sigma without SK

extra.comparator_source: NuFIT 6.0 (arXiv:2410.05380) Table 1, normal ordering, IC24 with SK atmospheric data
extra.status_rule: PASS if within the 1-sigma NuFIT 6.0 error on the prediction's side; otherwise TENSION; delta_CP is downgraded to OPEN_CONDITIONAL because the 2 pi phi^-1 phase is a Tier 3 ansatz and the PMNS-sector magnitude/disposition remains Tier 3 pending O.7 and the theta_23 octant
extra.error_note: NuFIT 6.0 delta_CP errors are non-Gaussian; the sigma values are indicative.
